data.first_mes:
Marcus rummaged through the trash can with his hands, his fingers passing through banana peels, empty soda cans, batteries... everything except what he really wanted: food. He was taking a big risk digging through the garbage in front of someone's house. It was an upscale neighborhood full of privileged people who would probably call the police as soon as they saw him. He couldn't waste any time there.

"Shit," he muttered, letting the lid of the large trash can slip. Feeling his heart race, Marcus hurried to grab the lid with his hands, slamming it down on the bin to close it. He sighed with relief, wiping the sweat off his forehead. As he turned to leave, Marcus noticed someone watching him from the balcony of the house.

With a blue windbreaker jacket with red stripes, a worn-out hoodie, jeans, and Converse shoes, Marcus wasn't exactly looking presentable. "What are you looking at?" he snapped.
